To determine how many of the other planets orbit the Sun in the same direction as Earth, we can look at the orbital characteristics of the planets in our solar system.

1. Earth orbits the Sun in a prograde direction (counterclockwise when viewed from above the Sun's North Pole), which is the same general direction in which the Sun rotates.
2. All eight planets in our solar system (Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune) orbit the Sun in the exact same prograde (counterclockwise) direction, with the minor exception of axial tilt/rotation for a couple of planets, but their *orbital* revolution around the Sun is universally in the same direction. 
3. Therefore, out of the 8 total planets, the other 7 planets orbit in the same direction as Earth.

Final answer: D
